title: Mac Storage Audit

done.name: Simulators
done.detail: Deleted 112 and kept one iPhone 17 Pro Max on iOS 26.5. Devices folder went from 45 GB to 5.1 GB.

done.name: Old iPhone debug symbols
done.detail: Deleted 9 iOS versions and kept the newest 2.

done.name: Docker Desktop disk
done.detail: `Docker.raw`, left behind after Docker Desktop was uninstalled. Moved to Trash, then emptied.

done.name: Simulator system caches
done.detail: Cleared with `xcrun simctl runtime dyld_shared_cache remove --all`, since macOS blocks deleting them by hand.

done.name: Old iOS simulator runtimes
done.detail: Deleted 18.1, 18.2, 18.4, 26.1, 26.2 and 26.4 and kept 26.5. 25 GB of their files are stuck.

done.name: Project build output
done.detail: 150 gitignored build, Pods, dist, .next, .gradle and .expo folders. Skipped vendor packages and anything git doesn't ignore.

done.name: Developer and app caches
done.detail: Yarn, Cypress, Playwright, CocoaPods, Spotify, Go, pnpm, Homebrew, Chrome-headless and Android Studio.

done.name: Android emulator Pixel_10_Pro_XL
done.detail: The whole virtual device. Moved to Trash, then emptied.

done.name: WhatsApp media
done.detail: Photos, videos and voice notes. Chats were kept.

done.name: CapCut projects
done.detail: Leftover data in `~/Movies/CapCut`. CapCut isn't installed.

done.name: pnpm package store
done.detail: Pruned the current store and deleted the old v3 and v10 stores.

done.name: Cursor app data
done.detail: Chat history, extension data and workspace state. Settings and keybindings were kept.

done.name: Chrome cache
done.detail: All 4 profiles, after Chrome was fully quit. Logins and history were kept.

done.name: Hugging Face models
done.detail: Three vision and speech models; they download again when needed.

stuck.name: iOS 18.1, 18.2 and 18.4 runtime files
stuck.detail: Xcode no longer lists these runtimes, but their files are still in `/System/Library/AssetsV2`. macOS protects them, so not even sudo can delete them. Check Xcode → Settings → Components; a restart may clear them.

items.name: Xcode build cache
items.note: Xcode rebuilds it on the next build. That first build is slower.

items.name: node_modules in 207 project folders
items.note: Biggest: mobile-app 13.8, shop-app 7.7, wallet-app 5.4, budget-app 2.9 GB. `yarn`, `npm` or `pnpm install` restores it.
items.cmd: rm -rf <project>/node_modules for the projects you name

items.name: OrbStack containers and images
items.note: Prune unused images and volumes from inside OrbStack. Deleting the disk image file by hand wipes every container.

items.name: Chrome profile data
items.note: History, extensions and site storage. Clear it from inside Chrome only.

items.name: Claude desktop VM bundles
items.note: Used by the Claude app's sandbox and downloaded again if missing.

items.name: Xcode Archives (32 builds)
items.note: Needed to read crash reports for shipped builds, unless the dSYMs are uploaded.

items.name: Genymotion virtual devices
items.note: Delete devices you no longer use from the Genymotion app.

items.name: promo-reel build folder
items.note: Probably a bundle that rebuilds. Check it for rendered videos before deleting.

keep.name: iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator
keep.detail: iOS 26.5, plus its 7.9 GB runtime. The one you chose to keep.

keep.name: macOS system volumes
keep.detail: System, Preboot, Recovery and VM · 23 GB

keep.name: Installed apps
keep.detail: `/Applications` · 23 GB. Uninstall apps you don't use rather than deleting their parts.

keep.name: PHP and Python dependencies
keep.detail: `build` and `dist` folders inside `vendor/` and `site-packages/` belong to packages.

notes: Run `pod install` before the next iOS build in projects whose Pods were removed. The first Android builds will be slow.
The first boot of the kept simulator is slow while macOS rebuilds its cache.
WhatsApp shows old photos and videos as needing a download. They come back only if they're still on the phone.
Cursor asks you to sign in again. Settings and keybindings were kept.
About 285 GB of folders were deleted, but the disk gained 264 GB. Some deleted files shared space with files that stay (APFS clones, pnpm hard links, sparse disk images).
Sizes are binary gigabytes, as `du` and `df` report them. Finder shows about 7% more.
questions: Which projects are active? Only inactive ones should lose node_modules.
Can OrbStack's unused images and volumes be pruned? That's the biggest item left.
